task: compare zero-quota ways to preserve small binary-semantic content in scheduled Chat

assumptions.material_outcome: durable exact octet semantics/replay, not execution of the payload
assumptions.repository_transport: ordinary low-volume text API is permitted; API rate limits require checkpoint/backoff and are not used as compute

candidates.name: single canonical base64 text object
candidates.success_probability: high for very small immutable payloads
candidates.conflict_duplication_risk: medium; one mutable/large text object creates a wider retry unit
candidates.monthly_quota_fragility: low within ordinary repository text, but no chunk-local recovery
candidates.residual_execution_dependency: none for semantic preservation; actual byte materialization remains unsupported

candidates.name: bounded canonical-base64 chunks plus immutable manifest and CAS/readback pointer
candidates.conflict_duplication_risk: low; chunks immutable, manifest published after readback, retry can reconcile by identity
candidates.monthly_quota_fragility: low; ordinary repository text only, bounded far below recommended single-object and directory limits
candidates.residual_execution_dependency: none for semantic preservation/replay/comparison; actual byte file/attachment consumption remains unsupported

candidates.name: Git LFS
candidates.success_probability: high for actual large binary files when quota is available
candidates.monthly_quota_fragility: REJECT: GitHub documents included LFS storage/bandwidth allowances and usage/billing behavior
candidates.residual_execution_dependency: requires LFS-capable consumer to materialize actual file

candidates.name: Actions/Codespaces/artifact or package storage
candidates.monthly_quota_fragility: REJECT: GitHub documents plan-based included usage for Actions/Codespaces/Packages

selected: bounded canonical-base64 chunks plus immutable manifest and CAS/readback pointer
falsification_boundary: Selection is invalid if the useful outcome requires an actual binary file/attachment/object to be materialized or consumed by an unavailable environment/API, or if payload scale exceeds conservative ordinary-text bounds. Those remain unresolved children; they are not converted into a handoff.
